evals.prompt: I changed the login redirect logic. Verify it before I open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs the relevant existing local tests first, launches the real app, exercises the changed login redirect end to end, probes a nearby edge case, and returns one evidence-backed verdict.
expectations: Runs an existing relevant local test command before runtime verification
Does not treat passing tests as a substitute for runtime observation
Exercises the changed behavior through a public/user-facing surface
Reports raw evidence and exactly one of PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or SKIP

evals.prompt: This is a CLI flag fix. Use /verify before the PR.
evals.expected_output: Runs relevant CLI tests locally, invokes the public CLI as a user would, checks the changed flag plus one nearby boundary case, and reports one verdict.
expectations: Invokes the public CLI rather than only importing an internal helper
Includes at least one adjacent edge probe

evals.prompt: I only changed README wording. Verify this change.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that there is no executable behavior to observe and returns SKIP without inventing runtime work.
expectations: Does not fabricate a runtime verification surface
Returns SKIP with a concise reason
